summary: 45, heavy regular periods, fatigue, no fainting
turns: My periods have gotten really heavy and I'm tired all the time.
They come every 27 or 28 days, but the first three days are very heavy. I change a pad about every 2 to 3 hours.
This has been going on for about 6 months.
No dizziness and I haven't fainted. I'm just exhausted.
I had my tubes tied years ago, so I can't get pregnant.
My last Pap was in 2022. I've never had a mammogram.
